description: Experiment D, query load (phase 14 work order 5, cloud window 2). Closed-loop GET load on graph-evidence-api through the ALB at concurrency 1, 2, 4 and 8, 180 s per level, 30 s between levels, 120 s idle observation at the end. Requests: /v1/evidence/<id>, /v1/graph/nodes/<researcherId>, /v1/graph/nodes/<researcherId>/neighbors (direction both, depth 1, limit 50, COAUTHORED_WITH), with IDs taken from the latest PASS smoke record. No /v1/query and no Haiku call: the deployed tasks set SCHOLARCHAIN_STUB_LLM=false (infra/terraform/envs/course/main.tf), and stubbing would need a task-definition change. Records per-request latency and status, p50/p95/p99, error rate, throughput, and graph-evidence-api desired/running/pending task counts before and after each level (aws ecs describe-services, read-only). Run by the human (ruling 29) after load-stores.sh and a PASS smoke-test.sh.

limits.abortScope: per request kind (evidence, node, neighbors): a sliding window within each level (a stop event checked by every worker before each request) and the whole level before the next one starts; trips when a kind has at least abortMinRequestsPerKind requests and a non-2xx rate above abortErrorRate, or abortConsecutive5xxOrTimeouts consecutive 5xx or transport errors (code review 4 finding 1)
limits.preflight: one GET of each request path before concurrency 1; any non-2xx stops the run (exit 3)
limits.exitCodes: 0 every level ran; 1 abort rule; 2 usage; 3 precondition or non-2xx preflight; 4 unexpected error
limits.scaleChanges: none by the harness; Application Auto Scaling may move graph-evidence-api between 1 and 2 (Terraform service_max_counts)

context.inputs: terraform output (alb_dns_name, api_key_secret_arn, ecs_cluster_name, account_id, runtime_enabled, alb_arn_suffix); Secrets Manager API key (memory only); latest PASS operations/releases/smoke-*.json
context.rawOutputs: inputs.json, preflight.json, requests-c<n>.csv, ecs-<before|after>-c<n>.json, ecs-post-observe.json, summary.json (per level: elapsedSeconds, throughput from it, and per-kind counts and percentiles; abortedAt and abortWindowCounts)
context.metricsNote: LoadBalancer is the value of terraform output alb_arn_suffix (app/scholarchain-course-api/<id>), known only after apply; the harness records it in raw/inputs.json. Container Insights is disabled, so task counts come from describe-services, not CloudWatch.
